fields.why: Each stratum's contrast is a pair (June 1-5 mean vs June 7), but the article ranks it across 8 regions ('largest region-specific increases') and 5 age groups, and the conclusions cite those groups. With no Summary to decide, group > pair applies.

No design is named. The Pearson correlations pair one regional monitor's daily PM2.5 with aggregate daily ED counts per region (group-level units), which supports ecologic; leaving it out is also defensible, since the report reads as before/after surveillance.

brief_issues: The framework precedence rule assumes a Summary; Notes from the Field have none. Saying which text stands in for it (e.g. the first sentence of Preliminary Conclusions) would settle these cases.
